relevant_controls_reviewed: G6 is a paired G3/G4 counterfactual comparison and paired_set_id binds variants of one base task.
The primary statistical unit is theory_family_id, not task variants or replicate rows.
All planned rows and failures remain in the denominator; no confirmatory conclusion is inferred from engineering tests.
G7 diagnoses failure locations but does not by itself establish a causal mechanism.
design_alignment_review.alignment_conclusion: The repaired input guard enforces the task identity needed before the design-specified family-clustered G3/G4 pairing. This is an engineering/statistical-input repair, not evidence that formal statistical validity or a scientific hypothesis has been established.

before_repair.command: Read-only synthetic validate_statistical_inputs probe with same family/CF/replicate but different G3/G4 case_id and paired_set_id
before_repair.result: FAIL_OPEN: the malformed pair was accepted

repair.change: validate_statistical_inputs now requires nonempty case_id and paired_set_id and compares both lineage fields across each G3/G4 pair before statistical analysis.

findings.title: G6 statistical pairing did not enforce same task lineage across G3 and G4
findings.evidence: The pre-repair synthetic probe accepted different case_id and paired_set_id values for G3 and G4 under one pairing key; the design requires same-task pairing.
findings.remediation: Require nonempty case_id and paired_set_id and reject mismatched G3/G4 lineage before summaries.
